gallery.alt: Video cover: a tall smooth pale-pink buttercream cake on a turntable as a pastel rainbow topper is placed ('Rainbows and unicorns'). A name in pink lettering is on the cake, so crop it. The signed URL expires around 29 Oct 2026.
Video cover: a two-tier smooth pink buttercream cake on a turntable in the baker's kitchen ('ALL THE PINKS'). The signed URL expires around 29 Oct 2026.
Video cover: a red and blue buttercream Spider-Man cake in progress, with decorations added from an orange cup. The signed URL expires around 29 Oct 2026.

Video cover: the baker holding a finished cow-print cowgirl cake with disco-ball decorations and a pink topper showing a child's name and '14'. It shows a person and a personal name, so crop or avoid. The signed URL expires around 29 Oct 2026.
Video cover: a three-tier smooth white buttercream cake on a turntable being finished with a piping bag (her own wedding cake video, Feb 2025). The signed URL expires around 29 Oct 2026.

notes: Logo: vector reconstruction (not the business's own vector file) of the 500x500 transparent PNG hosted on the Booked Events listing, which is identical to the @lucy_jane_cakes TikTok avatar. It was upscaled to 1500 px and posterised to its three flat colours (blush #f8dfdb, white #ffffff, hot pink #fa8fcd), with the original's bluish antialias fringe on the rim removed, then traced with logo_trace.py --colours 3 (render-back mean abs diff 0.68). Plate 'none': the mark carries its own solid blush circle.

No business website exists and Instagram is login-walled, so the business has no standalone high-resolution photos. Gallery photos 01, 02 and 05-09 are full-resolution still frames from the business's own public TikTok videos (1080x1920 sources). 03 is the TikTok cover of her wedding-cake video (540x960). 04 is the Booked Events listing cover (500x455, top 10 px trimmed to remove a social-media UI fragment). sourceUrl gives the TikTok post page because the signed cover/CDN URLs expire.

Privacy: several celebration cakes carry personal names (Romee, Teddy, Geri, Sophia, Shannon). Photo 05 is cropped above the name on the rainbow cake. The reel and gallery use only moments before named toppers are added, or with no names. The photo-cake tutorial was not used because the cake shows photographs of private individuals.

Reel: six clips from three of her TikTok posts ('ALL THE PINKS', 'Oink', 'Bento Love'), downloaded with yt-dlp --no-cookies, with audio stripped. Sources are vertical 9:16, so the desktop 16:9 reel is a horizontal band crop of each frame. Rejected: the 'Rainbows and unicorns' footage (a child's name is legible throughout), the Spider-Man cake (540p only, and a name topper is visible), and the cowgirl-cake scraper shot (the supplier LissieLou's logo is prominent on the scraper).

Oct 27 photo upgrade: card and gallery re-selected from original-resolution uploads on the business's own site and its own uploads on the old Booked Events site; AI renders, other businesses' images, private names and celebrity/watermarked shots excluded.
